-- Order Filter; order can be casting an ability, moving, clicking to attack, using scan (radar), glyph etc.
function barebones:OrderFilter(filter_table)
	--PrintTable(filter_table)

	local order = filter_table.order_type
	local units = filter_table.units
	local playerID = filter_table.issuer_player_id_const

	-- Order enums:
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_NONE = 0
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_POSITION = 1
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET = 2
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_MOVE = 3
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_TARGET = 4
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION = 5
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET = 6
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET_TREE = 7
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET = 8
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TOGGLE = 9
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_HOLD_POSITION = 10
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_TRAIN_ABILITY = 11
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_DROP_ITEM = 12
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_GIVE_ITEM = 13
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PICKUP_ITEM = 14
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PICKUP_RUNE = 15
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PURCHASE_ITEM = 16
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_SELL_ITEM = 17
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_DISASSEMBLE_ITEM = 18
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_ITEM = 19
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TOGGLE_AUTO = 20
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_STOP = 21
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_TAUNT = 22
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_BUYBACK = 23
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_GLYPH = 24
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_EJECT_ITEM_FROM_STASH = 25
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_RUNE = 26
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PING_ABILITY = 27
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_DIRECTION = 28
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PATROL = 29
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_VECTOR_TARGET_POSITION = 30
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_RADAR = 31
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_SET_ITEM_COMBINE_LOCK = 32
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CONTINUE = 33
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_VECTOR_TARGET_CANCELED = 34
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_RIVER_PAINT = 35
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_PREGAME_ADJUST_ITEM_ASSIGNMENT = 36
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_DROP_ITEM_AT_FOUNTAIN = 37
	-- DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_TAKE_ITEM_FROM_NEUTRAL_ITEM_STASH = 39

	-- Example 1: If the order is an ability
	if order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_POSITION or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TARGET or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_NO_TARGET or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TOGGLE or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_CAST_TOGGLE_AUTO then
		local ability_index = filter_table.entindex_ability
		local ability
		if ability_index then
			ability = EntIndexToHScript(ability_index)
		end
		local caster
		if units and units["0"] then
			caster = EntIndexToHScript(units["0"])
		end
	end

	-- Example 2: If the order is a simple move command
	if order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_POSITION and units then
		local destination_x = filter_table.position_x
		local destination_y = filter_table.position_y
		local destination_z = filter_table.position_z
		local unit_with_order
		if units["0"] then
			unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(units["0"])
		end

		if unit_with_order and playerID ~= nil and Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[playerID] then
			local mgr = Shop1Managers[playerID]
			local slot = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_with_order)
			if not slot and PlayerResource and PlayerResource.GetMainSelectedEntity then
				local mainEnt = PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
				if mainEnt and mainEnt ~= -1 then
					unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(mainEnt)
					slot = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_with_order)
				end
			end
			if mgr.ResolveShop1Dummy then
				unit_with_order = mgr:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit_with_order)
			end
			if slot then
				if mgr.debug then
					print("[Shop1Manager] Order MOVE_TO_POSITION slot", slot, "pos", destination_x, destination_y)
				end
				local pos = Vector(destination_x, destination_y, destination_z or 0)
				local synthSlot = mgr:FindSynthesizeTargetSlotByPos(slot, pos, 200)
				if synthSlot and mgr:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slot, synthSlot, synthSlot, false) then
					return false
				end
				if mgr:HandleDummyDrag(unit_with_order, pos, false) then
					return false
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Example 3: If the order is a move/attack target command
	if (order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_MOVE_TO_TARGET or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_ATTACK_TARGET) and units then
		local targetIndex = filter_table.entindex_target
		local target = targetIndex and EntIndexToHScript(targetIndex) or nil
		local unit_with_order
		if units["0"] then
			unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(units["0"])
		end

		if unit_with_order and target and playerID ~= nil and Shop1Managers and Shop1Managers[playerID] then
			local mgr = Shop1Managers[playerID]
			local slot = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_with_order)
			if not slot and PlayerResource and PlayerResource.GetMainSelectedEntity then
				local mainEnt = PlayerResource:GetMainSelectedEntity(playerID)
				if mainEnt and mainEnt ~= -1 then
					unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(mainEnt)
					slot = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(unit_with_order)
				end
			end
			if mgr.ResolveShop1Dummy then
				unit_with_order = mgr:ResolveShop1Dummy(unit_with_order)
			end
			if slot then
				local targetSlot = mgr:FindSlotByDummy(target)
				if targetSlot then
					if mgr.debug then
						print("[Shop1Manager] Order MOVE/ATTACK_TARGET slot", slot, "targetSlot", targetSlot)
					end
					if mgr:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slot, targetSlot, targetSlot, false) then
						return false
					end
					if mgr:HandleDummyDrag(unit_with_order, target:GetAbsOrigin(), true) then
						return false
					end
				else
					local synthSlot = mgr:FindSynthesizeTargetSlotByPos(slot, target:GetAbsOrigin(), 200)
					if synthSlot and mgr:SynthesizePairSlotsAnimated(slot, synthSlot, synthSlot, false) then
						return false
					end
					if mgr:HandleDummyDrag(unit_with_order, target:GetAbsOrigin(), false) then
						return false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Example 3: Disable item sharing for a custom courier that everyone can control
	--[[
	if order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_DROP_ITEM or order == DOTA_UNIT_ORDER_GIVE_ITEM then
		local unit_with_order = EntIndexToHScript(units["0"])
		local ability_index = filter_table.entindex_ability
		local ability = EntIndexToHScript(ability_index)

		if unit_with_order:IsCourier() and ability and ability:IsItem() then
			local purchaser = ability:GetPurchaser()
			if purchaser and purchaser:GetPlayerID() ~= playerID then
				CustomGameEventManager:Send_ServerToPlayer(PlayerResource:GetPlayer(playerID), "display_custom_error", { message = "#hud_error_courier_cant_order_item" })
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	]]

	return true
end

local function FindDummyAutocastProfile(attacker, damaging_ability)
	if not attacker or attacker:IsNull() then
		return nil, nil
	end

	local ability_name = damaging_ability and damaging_ability.GetAbilityName and damaging_ability:GetAbilityName() or
		nil
	local mods = attacker:FindAllModifiers()

	if mods then
		for _, mod in pairs(mods) do
			if mod and mod.GetName and mod:GetName() == "modifier_dummy_autocast" then
				if mod.GetProfileForAbilityName then
					local profile = mod:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name)
					if profile then
						return mod, profile
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local fallback = attacker:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_autocast")
	if fallback then
		local profile = fallback.GetProfileForAbilityName and fallback:GetProfileForAbilityName(ability_name) or nil
		return fallback, profile
	end

	return nil, nil
end

-- Damage filter function
function barebones:DamageFilter(keys)
	-- PrintTable(keys)

	local attacker
	local victim
	if keys.entindex_attacker_const and keys.entindex_victim_const then
		attacker = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_attacker_const)
		victim = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_victim_const)
	else
		return false
	end

	local original_attacker = attacker
	local original_victim = victim

	local inflictor = keys.entindex_inflictor_const -- nil if damage is not caused by an ability
	local damaging_ability = inflictor and EntIndexToHScript(inflictor) or nil
	local modifier_autocast, profile = FindDummyAutocastProfile(attacker, damaging_ability)

	if modifier_autocast then
		if profile then
			if profile.hit_label ~= nil then
				victim.hit_label = profile.hit_label
			end

			if profile.base_damage ~= nil then
				victim.base_damage = profile.base_damage
			end

			if profile.damage_scale ~= nil then
				victim.damage_scale = profile.damage_scale
			end

			if profile.pure_percent ~= nil then
				victim.pure_percent = profile.pure_percent
			end

			if profile.lifesteal ~= nil then
				victim.lifesteal = profile.lifesteal
			end

			if profile.career_damage_bonus_pct ~= nil then
				victim.career_damage_bonus_pct = profile.career_damage_bonus_pct
			end

			if profile.career_crit_chance_bonus_pct ~= nil then
				victim.career_crit_chance_bonus_pct = profile.career_crit_chance_bonus_pct
			end
		end

		if modifier_autocast.attacker_override and not modifier_autocast.attacker_override._is_evolving and modifier_autocast.attacker_override:IsRealHero() then
			attacker = modifier_autocast.attacker_override
			victim.last_real_attacker = attacker
		end
	end

	-- Damage types:
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_NONE = 0
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_PHYSICAL = 1
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL = 2
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_PURE = 4
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_ALL = 7
	-- DAMAGE_TYPE_HP_REMOVAL = 8

	-- Find the ability/item that dealt the dmg, if normal attack or no ability/item it will be nil
	-- damaging_ability resolved above

	if damaging_ability and damaging_ability._is_skill then
		local modifier_cast = original_attacker:FindModifierByName("modifier_dummy_cast")

		if modifier_cast then
			print("[Filter]", modifier_cast:GetName(), modifier_cast.hit_label, modifier_cast.base_damage)
			if modifier_cast.hit_label then
				victim.hit_label = modifier_cast.hit_label
			end

			if modifier_cast.base_damage then
				victim.base_damage = modifier_cast.base_damage
			end

			if modifier_cast.pure_percent then
				victim.pure_percent = modifier_cast.pure_percent
			end

			if modifier_cast.attacker_override and not modifier_cast.attacker_override._is_evolving and modifier_cast.attacker_override:IsRealHero() then
				attacker = modifier_cast.attacker_override
				victim.last_real_attacker = attacker
			end
		end
	end

	local damage_type             = keys.damagetype_const
	local damage_after_reductions = keys.damage -- keys.damage is damage after reductions without spell amplifications

	-- Lack of entities handling (illusions error fix)
	if attacker:IsNull() or victim:IsNull() then
		return false
	end

	local victim_owner = victim:GetOwner()

	if victim_owner and victim_owner == attacker and damage_type == 0 and damaging_ability == nil then
		return false
	end

	keys.damage = damage_system:ProcessDamage(attacker, victim, keys)

	if victim.transfer_damage then
		local new_victim = victim:GetOwner()
		if new_victim and not new_victim:IsNull() then
			ApplyDamage({
				attacker = attacker,
				victim = new_victim,
				damage = keys.damage,
				damage_type = keys.damagetype_const,
				ability = damaging_ability,
			})

			-- print("[Transfer Damage]", attacker:GetUnitName(), new_victim:GetUnitName(), keys.damage)

			return false
		end
	end

	-- Update the gold bounty of the hero before he dies
	if USE_CUSTOM_HERO_GOLD_BOUNTY then
		if attacker:IsControllableByAnyPlayer() and victim:IsRealHero() and not victim:IsSpiritBearCustom() and not victim:IsTempestDouble() and not victim:IsClone() and damage_after_reductions >= victim:GetHealth() then
			-- Get his killing streak
			local hero_streak = victim:GetStreak()
			-- Get his level
			local hero_level = victim:GetLevel()
			-- Adjust Gold bounty
			local gold_bounty
			if hero_streak > 2 then
				gold_bounty = HERO_KILL_GOLD_BASE + hero_level * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_LEVEL +
					(hero_streak - 2) * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_STREAK
			else
				gold_bounty = HERO_KILL_GOLD_BASE + hero_level * HERO_KILL_GOLD_PER_LEVEL
			end

			victim:SetMinimumGoldBounty(gold_bounty)
			victim:SetMaximumGoldBounty(gold_bounty)
		end
	end

	return true
end

-- Modifier (buffs, debuffs) filter function
function barebones:ModifierFilter(keys)
	--PrintTable(keys)

	local unit_with_modifier
	if keys.entindex_parent_const then
		unit_with_modifier = EntIndexToHScript(keys.entindex_parent_const)
	end
	local modifier_name = keys.name_const
	local modifier_duration = keys.duration
